title: Puevlo Escondido - Oceanfront Penthouse
description:
This magnificent oceanfront penthouse offers the most spectacular views of the Caribbean Sea from every room, creating an unparalleled luxury living experience. The property features expansive open areas complemented by beautiful gardens, pristine pools, and unique saltwater ponds, all positioned directly in front of the gorgeous Caribbean coastline.

With an impressive interior space of 2,486 square feet and a stunning roof garden of 1,189 square feet, this penthouse totals 3,675 square feet of pure luxury. The thoughtful design ensures breathtaking ocean views from the kitchen, living room, and at least two bedrooms, making every moment a celebration of coastal living.

This completely furnished penthouse showcases exceptional attention to detail with first-quality finishings including hardwood, marble, granite, and natural stones. Premium features include double windows with hidden hurricane shutters, a private terrace jacuzzi, individual air conditioning, high-speed internet, satellite TV, and elevator access.

The exclusive oceanfront community provides world-class amenities including private parking, bike storage, 24-hour security, freshwater pools, saltwater ponds, oceanfront terraces with palapas and pergolas, golf course access, full-service marina, tennis facilities, dolphin encounters, boutique shopping, pristine beaches, and water activities including diving, kayaking, and snorkeling.
highlights: Oceanfront penthouse with Caribbean Sea views from all rooms
3,675 sq ft total space with roof garden
Premium amenities including 2 pools and a gym
Gated community with marina and golf
